acutely: She was acutely aware that everyone in the room was watching her.
她强烈地意识到房间里的每个人都在看着她。
consultation: After a long consultation with his parents, he finally chose the medical course.
与父母长时间商议之后，他最终选择了医学课程。
derail: A sudden lack of funds could derail the whole building project.
资金的突然短缺可能会使整个建筑工程脱轨。
guesstimate: I'd guesstimate that about fifty people came to the party last night.
我大概估计昨晚大约有五十个人来参加了聚会。
tangled: The little boy couldn't get his finger out of the tangled string.
小男孩的手指从缠结的绳子里拔不出来。
shrank: My old wool sweater shrank badly after I washed it in hot water.
我用热水洗过之后，我的旧羊毛衫缩水得很厉害。
adversely: The new tax policy will adversely affect thousands of small businesses.
新税收政策将对成千上万的小企业产生不利影响。
privileged: As a privileged student, he had access to the best teachers and books.
作为一名享有特权的优等生，他能接触到最好的老师和书籍。
intensely: She missed her hometown intensely during her first year at university.
上大学的第一年，她非常强烈地思念家乡。
squalor: The family lived in squalor after the father lost his job.
父亲失业后，一家人生活在肮脏的环境之中。
disengagement: His gradual disengagement from the club surprised all of his close friends.
他逐渐脱离这个俱乐部，让所有亲近的朋友都感到惊讶。
segregation: The city finally ended the segregation of students by race in its schools.
这座城市最终结束了学校里按种族隔离学生的做法。
restructure: The company plans to restructure its departments to save money next year.
公司计划明年调整部门结构以节省开支。
untreated: Untreated waste water from the factory flows directly into the small river.
工厂未经处理的废水直接流进这条小河。
wishful: It is just wishful thinking to believe the exam will be cancelled.
认为考试会被取消纯粹是一厢情愿的想法。
footnote: The meaning of this old word is explained in a footnote at the bottom of the page.
这个古词的意思在页面底部的注脚中有解释。
mournful: We could hear the mournful sound of a train far away in the night.
我们能听到夜里远处火车发出的悲哀的呜咽声。
apathy: Voters' apathy was clear because fewer than half of them came to vote.
选民的冷漠显而易见，因为前来投票的人不到一半。
incompatibility: The incompatibility between the two programs often causes the computer to crash.
这两个程序之间的不兼容常常导致电脑死机。
aspirational: Her aspirational attitude pushed her to apply for the best university in the country.
她渴望成功的心态促使她申请了全国最好的大学。
donor: A generous donor gave the school enough money to build a new library.
一位慷慨的捐赠者给了学校足够的钱来建造一座新图书馆。
disproportionately: Poor families are disproportionately affected by the rising cost of housing.
上涨的住房成本对贫困家庭的影响尤其不成比例。
mining: Mining is still the most important industry in this small mountain town.
采矿业仍然是这座山区小镇最重要的产业。
dynamics: The teacher studied the dynamics of the group before choosing the team leader.
老师在选队长之前研究了这个小组的互动动态。
untiring: Her untiring efforts finally helped the team win the city championship.
她不知疲倦的努力最终帮助球队赢得了市冠军。
rewarding: Teaching children to read is one of the most rewarding jobs in the world.
教孩子阅读是世界上最让人有成就感的工作之一。
carpentry: My grandfather learned carpentry when he was young and built all our furniture.
我祖父年轻时学了木工活，我们家的家具都是他做的。
seasick: Take this pill before boarding the ship, or you will feel seasick.
上船前把这片药吃了，不然你会晕船的。
uninformed: People are often uninformed about the real risks of smoking cigarettes.
人们常常对吸烟的真正危害一无所知。
Automatically: The doors of the supermarket open automatically when you walk up to them.
当你走近时，超市的门会自动打开。
accountable: Managers should be accountable for the safety of everyone in the factory.
管理者应该对工厂里每个人的安全负责。
fertility: Farmers add natural fertilizer to improve the fertility of the soil.
农民添加天然肥料来提高土壤的肥力。
incompetent: The court decided that the incompetent driver was responsible for the accident.
法庭认定那位不胜任驾驶的司机对事故负有责任。
recyclable: Please put all recyclable materials such as paper and glass into this green box.
请把纸张和玻璃等所有可回收的材料放进这个绿色箱子里。
reproduction: Scientists studied the reproduction of fish in the cold mountain lake.
科学家研究了这座寒冷高山湖泊中鱼类的繁殖。
degeneration: Lack of exercise can lead to the degeneration of muscles in old people.
缺乏锻炼会导致老年人肌肉退化。
justifiable: Her anger was justifiable because they had lied to her for years.
她的愤怒是理所应当的，因为他们骗了她多年。
immersive: The museum offers an immersive experience where visitors feel like they are inside history.
博物馆提供身临其境的体验，游客感觉自己仿佛置身于历史之中。
underfunded: The local hospital is seriously underfunded and cannot buy new equipment.
当地医院资金严重不足，无法购买新设备。
intolerant: He is intolerant of any noise while he is working on important papers.
他在处理重要文件时无法容忍任何噪音。
